name: Build ChameleonUltra Firmware (DFU Only)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - lf-viking-support

jobs:
  build-firmware:
    name: Build DFU Firmware
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Install ARM GCC and dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install -y build-essential gcc-arm-none-eabi libusb-1.0-0-dev cmake make

      - name: Create build directory and compile
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake ..
          make

      - name: Upload DFU firmware
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: Firmware .ultra APP DFU Package
          path: build/chameleon-ultra*.dfu
